title: Defenses Against Prompt Attacks Learn Surface Heuristics

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating concatenated benign prompts and comparing the refusal rates and task accuracy between the first task and subsequent tasks placed later in the prompt.
Inserting specific attack-associated trigger tokens into otherwise benign prompts and measuring the increase in false refusal rates compared to matched controls.
Measuring the degradation of task accuracy on benign reasoning benchmarks (e.g., GPQA, MMLU, AIME) drawn from unfamiliar topical domains absent from the defense training data.
